x-sections.title: General
x-sections.description: The width and indentation of lines, line endings, and what is formatted in all the languages.

x-sections.title: JavaScript and TypeScript
x-sections.description: The punctuation, spaces and line breaks of JavaScript and TypeScript.

x-sections.title: JSX, HTML and Vue
x-sections.description: The quotes, attributes and white space of elements.

lineWidth.description: The line width that the formatter wraps at. Defaults to the `lineWidth` of the global configuration. Same as `printWidth`, which takes precedence.

indentWidth.description: The number of spaces per level of indentation. Defaults to the `indentWidth` of the global configuration. Same as `tabWidth`, which takes precedence.

newLineKind.description: The kind of line ending. Defaults to the `newLineKind` of the global configuration. Same as `endOfLine`, which takes precedence.

oneOf.description: The line ending that the file has first.
Line feed.
Carriage return, line feed.

singleQuote.description: Whether to use single quotes instead of double quotes.

bracketSpacing.description: Whether to print spaces between the brackets of object literals.

bracketSameLine.description: Whether to put the `>` of a multi-line HTML or JSX element at the end of the last line instead of alone on the next line.

input: const button = <button className="primary large" type="submit" onClick={() => save(form)} disabled={busy}>Save</button>;

htmlWhitespaceSensitivity.description: How the white space of HTML, Vue and Handlebars is handled.

oneOf.description: Respect the default value of the CSS `display` property.
White space around all tags is significant.
White space around all tags is insignificant.

input: A label that is long enough to be wrapped
A paragraph that is long enough to be wrapped

singleAttributePerLine.description: Whether to put each attribute of an HTML, Vue or JSX element on its own line when there is more than one.

vueIndentScriptAndStyle.description: Whether to indent the code inside the `<script>` and `<style>` tags of Vue files.

arrowParens.description: Whether the only parameter of an arrow function has parentheses.

oneOf.description: Always have parentheses. Example: `(x) => x`
Omit the parentheses when possible. Example: `x => x`

semi.description: Whether to print semicolons at the ends of statements.

experimentalTernaries.description: Whether to format ternaries with the question mark at the end of the line of the condition.

input: const animal = isBird ? "bird" : isCat ? "cat" : isDog ? "dog" : "some other kind of animal";

jsxSingleQuote.description: Whether to use single quotes instead of double quotes in JSX.

quoteProps.description: When the properties of objects are quoted.

oneOf.description: Only add quotes where they are required.
If at least one property of an object requires quotes, quote all of them.
Keep the quotes as they are written.

trailingComma.description: Where trailing commas are printed in what is on multiple lines.

oneOf.description: Wherever possible, including the parameters and arguments of functions.
Where they are valid in ES5 (objects, arrays, etc.).
Nowhere.

input: function createUser(firstName: string, lastName: string, email: string, age: number) {
return { firstName, lastName, email, age, createdAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date() };

proseWrap.description: How the prose of Markdown is wrapped.

oneOf.description: Wrap prose when it exceeds the print width.
Unwrap each block of prose into one line.
Keep the prose as it is written.

input: A paragraph that is longer than the print width, which is eighty characters by default.

endOfLine.description: The kind of line ending. Defaults to `newLineKind`.

oneOf.description: Line feed (`\n`), common on Linux and macOS as well as inside git repos.
Carriage return and line feed (`\r\n`), common on Windows.
Carriage return (`\r`), used very rarely.
The line ending that the file has first.

printWidth.description: The line width that the formatter wraps at. Defaults to `lineWidth`.

tabWidth.description: The number of spaces per level of indentation. Defaults to `indentWidth`.

useTabs.description: Whether to indent with tabs instead of spaces. Defaults to the `useTabs` of the global configuration.

embeddedLanguageFormatting.description: Whether to format code that is embedded in a file. Example: CSS in a template literal of JavaScript.

oneOf.description: Format embedded code if it can be identified.
Never format embedded code.
